info.title: AI Act Classification Assistant API
info.description: Classifies AI systems under the EU AI Act, step by step with citations, and looks up the texts and duties it relies on. Every result is guidance, not legal advice.

post.description:
Classify one AI system under the AI Act, streaming each step as it runs and then the
result (or an `error` event, and no class, when a check fails). Guidance, not legal
advice.

200.description: The run's events, one JSON object per SSE `data:` line, named by its `event` field: `facts`, then `step_started` and `step` for each check, then `result` or `error`.

422.description: Not a valid request; the body quotes none of it

503.description: Every slot is taken (with Retry-After), or the engine is not configured

get.description:
The exact text of one article, paragraph, annex point, recital or guideline passage, in
the language asked for; the English text, with `english_only` set, when there is no German
one.

Draft the vendor letter the result calls for: a message about a prohibited result, or a
request for the vendor's assessment of a legally ambiguous one. Guidance, not legal
advice.

Every document the result calls for, with the duty it answers and its guided interview,
not yet drafted.

AnswerOption.title: AnswerOption
AnswerOption.description: An answer the interface offers to a yes/no follow-up question (E12).

provision_id.title: Provision Id
provision_id.description: The provision a yes rests on, for example `annex:I:A:11`.

duties_from.title: Duties From
duties_from.description: The date the route's high-risk duties apply from under the Art. 113 of the result's law version (the original text's dates for an original-text run, E11); None when the AI Act itself sets no duties (an Annex I Section B product, Art. 2(2)).

AnswerOutcome.title: AnswerOutcome
AnswerOutcome.description:
What a "yes" settles, where the step asking knows it: the class and, for high-risk, the
route, the provision and the date the duties apply from (decision 026 items 13 and 18). A
"no" has no such outcome: no class is predicted before the remaining checks run, so the
interface shows the fixed sentence of decision 026 item 13 instead.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult
CheckResult.description: One check's outcome. `problems` names each failure; it passes when there are none.

CheckedDraft.title: CheckedDraft
CheckedDraft.description: A drafted document, its three automatic checks and its interview, in the order asked.

label.title: Label
label.description: The duty's short label in the report's language (`label_en`, `label_de`).

is_done.title: Is Done
is_done.description: The user ticked the duty off.

ChecklistDuty.title: ChecklistDuty
ChecklistDuty.description: A tool's duty, and whether the user ticked it off.

language.description: The language of the checklist's wording and notice.

company.title: Company
company.description: The company's name from its profile; null without one.

ChecklistRequest.title: ChecklistRequest
ChecklistRequest.description:
Every tool of the user's inventory, summarised with each duty's ticked state, and the
checklist wanted.

name.title: Name
name.description: Null when the user gave none: "Your tool".

also_role.description: The tool's second role, when the result gives one.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date the result applies the law as of.

ChecklistTool.title: ChecklistTool
ChecklistTool.description: A tool of the inventory, its stored result summarised, each duty with its ticked state.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The cited document's manifest `doc_key` (`data/manifest.yaml`), for example `ai-act-consolidated` or `guide-prohibited`; the citation checks resolve it against the corpus `documents.doc_key`.

law_version.description: The AI Act text quoted; None for guidance, which belongs to neither text.

document_status.description: Lets draft guidance be labelled as a draft.

changed_by_omnibus.title: Changed By Omnibus
changed_by_omnibus.description: The quoted amended text is one the Digital Omnibus changed: the provision, a part of it or the provision it belongs to was replaced, inserted, deleted or amended (INIT > Corpus rules). Never set on the original text.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: One quoted provision. `english_only` marks guidance that has no official text in `de`.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: In the Act's check order; empty only for a needs-a-description result.

risk_class.description: The headline class; null exactly when the run ended before the checks because the description was too thin to start (needs a description, E13).

role.description: Set exactly when the role_obligations step ran.

also_role.description: A role the company keeps next to `role`, whose duties are listed too: a deployer that becomes the provider still uses the system (shown as "You also use it").

role_switch_reason.title: Role Switch Reason
role_switch_reason.description: Why the Art. 25 switch to provider applies, when it does.

transparency_duties.title: Transparency Duties
transparency_duties.description: Art. 50 provisions that apply, for example `art:50:1`.

law_text.description: The label of the text `law_version` names (CELEX number and date); it always matches `law_version`, which sets it when it is left out.

legal_review.title: Legal Review
legal_review.description: The recommendation to have the result reviewed by a lawyer, in the result's language: set for high-risk, prohibited and legally ambiguous results (INIT > Ethical considerations).

not_assessed.title: Not Assessed
not_assessed.description: The checks the model provider refused to assess (decision 029), in check order; each needs a person's review, and its stricter reading is assumed.

ClassificationResult.title: ClassificationResult
ClassificationResult.description:
The engine's answer. When `status` is uncertain, `risk_class` is the stricter reading,
kept as the labelled working assumption.

ClassifyRequest.title: ClassifyRequest
ClassifyRequest.description:
One classification, as a caller asks for it (the body the API and the MCP tool reuse).
`as_of` defaults to the run's date. The text is bounded before any paid call: the
description as the database stores it (`systems.description`), and the answers in number
and length. What retrieval leaves out is not part of it (see `run_classification`).

DocumentInfo.title: DocumentInfo
DocumentInfo.description: One text of the corpus, as the interface lists it.

DocumentKind.title: DocumentKind
DocumentKind.description:
What a document is, which says how the screen words its interview and lays it out: a
skeleton gets the section-by-section layout (artboard `DocSkeleton`).

DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus
DocumentStatus.description: The status of a corpus document (matches F4's `documents.status`).

note.title: Note
note.description: A line under the title: for an SME or a small mid-cap, that a simplified technical documentation form is expected (P8b).

law_version.description: The AI Act text of the result drafted from.

DraftDocument.title: DraftDocument
DraftDocument.description: A document drafted from a classification result and the user's answers.

result.title: Result
result.description: A `ClassificationResult`, as the `result` event of `POST /classify` carries it; the route validates it against the result contract.

language.description: The language of the draft's wording and notice.

size_class.description: The company profile's size class; null without a profile.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The answers stored for this document, by question key.

DraftRequest.title: DraftRequest
DraftRequest.description: One document of the result, with the user's answers to its interview.

question_keys.title: Question Keys
question_keys.description: The interview questions whose answers fill the section, in the order asked; interview sections only.

unanswered.title: Unanswered
unanswered.description: The questions of `question_keys` still to answer, in order.

requirement.description: The requirement the section answers, quoted word for word from the AI Act (skeletons only); shown above the "To fill in" marker.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: The provisions a pre-filled section quotes, word for word from the corpus at the result's law version and date, in the document's language, never from the result: the Art. 5(1) points of the vendor message's finding.

DraftSection.title: DraftSection
DraftSection.description: One section of a drafted document. No paragraphs means it is still "To fill in".

DraftStatus.title: DraftStatus
DraftStatus.description: A document's state on the documents list: "Needs N answers" or "Ready to review".

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: A node failed, so the run stopped without a result.

EvidenceTag.title: EvidenceTag
EvidenceTag.description: Where a fact came from; used instead of a numeric confidence score.

result.title: Result
result.description: A `ClassificationResult`, as the `result` event of `POST /classify` carries it; the route validates it against the result contract.

language.description: The language of the draft's wording and notice.

size_class.description: The company profile's size class; null without a profile.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The answers stored for this document, by question key.

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description: One document as `draft_document` drafts it, and the file wanted.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: A fact about the system and where it came from. Only stated facts point into the text.

FactsEvent.title: FactsEvent
FactsEvent.description:
The facts the description states, implies or leaves assumed, and the questions they
raise; the interface shows these while the checks run.

about.title: About
about.description: What the answer settles, for example a step or provision_id.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: Why the answer matters, naming the provision it decides, or examples of an answer (a needs-a-description question), in the result's language.

options.title: Options
options.description: The answers offered: yes, no and not sure for a yes/no question; empty for a question answered in words.

if_yes.description: What a yes settles, when the step knows it.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: The provisions the question rests on, quoted; on a step's missing fact, each is one of the step's own (checked) citations.

FollowUpQuestion.title: FollowUpQuestion
FollowUpQuestion.description: A key-fact question. Its `id` keys the user's answer when the engine runs again.

HighRiskRoute.title: HighRiskRoute
HighRiskRoute.description: How a system became high-risk; the two routes have different dates (Art. 113(c)).

title.title: Title
title.description: The document's title once this choice is picked; null keeps its own.

InterviewChoice.title: InterviewChoice
InterviewChoice.description: One answer a choice question offers: the key stored as the answer, and its label.

section.title: Section
section.description: The key of the section the answer fills.

InterviewQuestion.title: InterviewQuestion
InterviewQuestion.description:
One question of a document's guided interview, and the section its answer fills. A choice
question lists its `choices`; its answer is one of their keys.

loc.title: Loc
loc.description: Where it failed, e.g. ["body", "answers"]; at most two parts.

InvalidField.title: InvalidField
InvalidField.description: One validation failure: its type (e.g. `string_too_long`) and where it is.

label.title: Label
label.description: The duty's short label in the report's language (`label_en`, `label_de`).

InventoryDuty.title: InventoryDuty
InventoryDuty.description: One duty of a tool's stored result, as the report lists it.

language.description: The language of the report's wording and notice.

company.title: Company
company.description: The company's name from its profile; null without one.

InventoryReportRequest.title: InventoryReportRequest
InventoryReportRequest.description: Every tool of the user's inventory, summarised, and the report wanted.

name.title: Name
name.description: Null when the user gave none: "Your tool".

also_role.description: The tool's second role, when the result gives one.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date the result applies the law as of.

InventoryTool.title: InventoryTool
InventoryTool.description:
One tool of the inventory and the summary of its latest stored result; a tool with no
result Klar can read has no class.

Language.title: Language
Language.description: The languages the assistant answers and quotes in.

version_date.title: Version Date
version_date.description: The original's publication date in the Official Journal, or the consolidation's cut-off date.

LawText.title: LawText
LawText.description:
The AI Act text a result was checked against, as the screens label it ("the consolidated
AI Act of 27 July 2026", CELEX 02024R1689-20260727).

LawVersion.title: LawVersion
LawVersion.description: The AI Act text a result relies on: as published in 2024, or as amended by the Omnibus.

LegacyStatus.title: LegacyStatus
LegacyStatus.description:
How Art. 111(2) treats a high-risk system placed on the market or put into service before
its route's Chapter III date, with no significant change planned from that date.

result.title: Result
result.description: A `ClassificationResult`, as the `result` event of `POST /classify` carries it; the route validates it against the result contract.

language.description: The language of the titles and the questions.

ListRequest.title: ListRequest
ListRequest.description: A tool's classification result and the language of the list.

kind.description: What the document is: a skeleton is laid out section by section.

ListedDocument.title: ListedDocument
ListedDocument.description: A document the result calls for, as the documents list shows it before it is drafted.

key.title: Key
key.description: The duty's key in the obligations table (e.g. `hr-deployer-logs`), the one a tick on the Obligations screen is saved under (`duty_progress.obligation_key`); None on a duty stored before the key was added.

duty_de.title: Duty De
duty_de.description: The formal duty in German, in the official German text's terms.

label_en.title: Label En
label_en.description: A short plain label, as an action: "Keep the logs it creates for at least six months".

group.description: The provider layout's group (`build`, `prove`, `after_launch`); set on every high-risk provider duty and only on duties a provider has. A duty shared with another role keeps it there too (so a provider that also uses the system gets the duty once); only the provider layout shows it.

document.title: Document
document.description: The drafting template that answers this duty (e.g. `art_26_2_oversight`), if any.

high_risk_route.description: The high-risk route `applies_from` belongs to; None when the date is the same for every route (or the class is not high-risk).

applies_if.title: Applies If
applies_if.description: The condition under which the duty applies; None when it applies to every system of this role and class.

is_informational.title: Is Informational
is_informational.description: True when the row informs (e.g. a distributor of a prohibited system) rather than stating a formal duty the Act puts on this role.

legacy.description: Art. 111(2) for a system on the market or in use before its route's date: `legacy_unchanged` means the duty applies only after a significant change to the system's design or purpose; `legacy_public_authority` means it applies from 2 Aug 2030 (`applies_from`). None when the system is not such a legacy system or the duty is not a high-risk one.

relief_note.title: Relief Note
relief_note.description: Relief for SMEs, start-ups and small mid-caps (SMCs), if any.

Obligation.title: Obligation
Obligation.description:
One duty with its article reference and the date it applies from.

Each duty carries its texts in both languages, so a screen can switch language without a
new lookup: a short plain label (an action, for the checklists) and the formal duty (for the
report).

ObligationGroup.title: ObligationGroup
ObligationGroup.description:
Where a provider duty sits in the provider layout (C9, decision 026; artboard
`ResultProvider`).

ObligationList.title: ObligationList
ObligationList.description: The duties `list_obligations` found, with the law version they come from and the notice.

readings.title: Readings
readings.description: The two possible readings, stricter first; the stricter one is applied.

settled_by.title: Settled By
settled_by.description: What would settle the question, when the step knows it.

OpenQuestion.title: OpenQuestion
OpenQuestion.description: A question the law and guidance don't settle, with both possible readings.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a section's content comes from; the interface shows it as a tag on the section.

Provision.title: Provision
Provision.description: One provision's text, with the version, language and status it comes from and the notice.

title.title: Title
title.description: None for a reading without its own title: a baseline's, or one stored before E12.

risk_class.description: The class this reading gives on its own check, for example `high_risk` for the stricter reading of a high-risk question. None when it gives no class by itself: the remaining checks decide (shown as, for example, not high-risk on this point), or the question is about a duty or the role, not the class.

citation.description: The provision the reading rests on: one of its step's citations.

consequence.title: Consequence
consequence.description: What follows if the reading holds.

is_applied.title: Is Applied
is_applied.description: The working assumption: the stricter reading, applied until a lawyer or the user's answer settles the question.

Reading.title: Reading
Reading.description:
One possible reading of an open question of law (E12): what it is called, the class it
gives, why, the provision it rests on, and what follows if it holds.

result.title: Result
result.description: The classification result, as `POST /classify` sent it.

language.description: The language of the report's wording and notice.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: The tool's name; null when the user gave none ("Your tool").

company.title: Company
company.description: The company's name from its profile; null without one.

ResultReportRequest.title: ResultReportRequest
ResultReportRequest.description: One tool's result, and the report wanted.

RiskClass.title: RiskClass
RiskClass.description: The headline class. Every result carries exactly one.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: The operator role the obligations follow from (Art. 3, 16, 23-26).

SectionStatus.title: SectionStatus
SectionStatus.description: A section's state, as the DocSkeleton artboard shows it beside the section.

SettledBy.title: SettledBy
SettledBy.description:
Something that would settle an open question. Guidance is named as it stands (for example
a draft); naming it never promises that the result is checked again (decision 026 item 4).

SettledByKind.title: SettledByKind
SettledByKind.description: What could settle an open question of law (E12, decision 026 item 4).

SizeClass.title: SizeClass
SizeClass.description:
The company profile's size class (P19's `inventories.size_class`), passed in by the
caller: derived from the profile's bands, never from the description.

SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan
SourceSpan.description: Character offsets `[start, end)` of a fact in the user's description.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Whether a step or result is settled. The two uncertain values are not risk classes.

StepEvent.title: StepEvent
StepEvent.description: A check finished, with its step as the result will show it.

StepName.title: StepName
StepName.description: The checks in the Act's fixed order (INIT > How it works).

missing_fact.description: The question that would supply the missing fact.

error.title: Error
error.description: A machine-readable failure code, for example `citation_unverified`.

StepResult.title: StepResult
StepResult.description: The outcome of one check. An uncertain status names what is missing or open.

StepStartedEvent.title: StepStartedEvent
StepStartedEvent.description: A check started: the interface marks it running.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: The validation failures, when the request failed validation.

Unprocessable.title: Unprocessable
Unprocessable.description: A 422: why the request can't be processed, quoting none of it.

VendorLetter.title: VendorLetter
VendorLetter.description: The drafted letter (labelled DRAFT, with the notice) and the automatic checks on it.

result.title: Result
result.description: The classification result, as `POST /classify` sent it.

language.description: The language of the letter's wording, its quotes of the Act and the notice.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The interview answers by question key (vendor, tool_name, sender); a question left out stays "To fill in".

VendorLetterRequest.title: VendorLetterRequest
VendorLetterRequest.description: A classification result, the letter's language and the answers given so far.

aiact__api__drafts__DocumentList.title: DocumentList
aiact__api__drafts__DocumentList.description: Every document the result calls for, in the order the documents list shows them.

aiact__retrieval__documents__DocumentLis.title: DocumentList
aiact__retrieval__documents__DocumentLis.description: Every text the answers can draw on, in `doc_key` order, with the notice.
